name: heading
label: Heading
default: One survey, one score, and a clear order of work.

name: total_weeks
label: Total weeks shown on the ruler
help_text: How many week columns the timeline ruler shows. Each step below is placed by its own Start week and Duration, so this just needs to be at least as large as the last step's end week.

name: steps
label: Steps
help_text: Up to four, one per colour in the fixed pink-to-red ramp (step 1 lightest, step 4 full red) -- matching the live page's own steps.

children.name: start_week
children.label: Start week
children.help_text: Which week column this step's bar starts in, e.g. 2 for "Weeks 2 to 4".

children.name: duration_weeks
children.label: Duration (weeks)
children.help_text: How many week columns the bar spans, e.g. 3 for "Weeks 2 to 4".

children.name: when_label
children.label: "When" label
children.help_text: Shown above the step title, e.g. "Week 1" or "Weeks 2 to 4".
